name: How long does a custom woodwork project typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom woodwork project typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a custom woodwork project varies significantly based on its complexity, size, and the chosen materials. A small, simple piece might take a few weeks from design to installation, while a large, intricate built-in system could take several months. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial design and material selection are finalized, giving you a clear understanding of the expected duration. Early planning and clear communication of your vision can help streamline the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; small items may take weeks, while complex systems can take months. We provide a detailed schedule after design finalization.
